🎥🎬: Green Lantern: Emerald Knights (2011)

The story follows Hal Jordan as he returns to Oa with a new recruit, Arisia Rrab, just as the Green Lantern Corps prepares for a major threat. To help Arisia understand the responsibility of being a Lantern, Hal and other Corps members share stories about some of the greatest Lanterns in their history.

Through these stories, Arisia learns about legendary battles, sacrifice, courage, and the incredible power of the Green Lantern Corps. But the lessons become real when the ancient villain Krona returns, forcing the Lanterns to put their differences aside and defend Oa from destruction.

As Krona’s attack reaches its climax, Hal, Arisia, and the Corps stand together in a massive battle. Arisia proves that she is ready to become a true Green Lantern, while the Corps demonstrates that their greatest strength isn’t just their rings—it’s their ability to overcome fear and fight together.

source_details.synopsis: Green Lantern: Emerald Knights is a 2011 American animated superhero film that tells various stories featuring members of Green Lantern Corps, including Abin Sur, Laira, Kilowog, and Mogo. It was released on June 7, 2011. While not a direct sequel to First Flight, the film uses the same character designs. It is the eleventh film released under the DC Universe Animated Original Movies banner. It is also the second DC Animated Movie following Batman: Gotham Knight to feature an anthology format, though unlike the latter, it features a single, uniform animation and visual style and an overall linking story.
